subtitle: Lesson 30 · Joining Tables

eyebrow: Keep every row, even with no match
code:
SELECT p.BusinessEntityID, ci.FirstName, ci.LastName
FROM Person.Person AS p
OUTER APPLY dbo.ufnGetContactInformation(p.BusinessEntityID)
    AS ci;
caption: If the function returns nothing, ci.FirstName/LastName come back NULL — the row is still kept.
